units.source_text: 薰中纳言把今春遭了火灾的三条宫邸重新建造，准备像模像样地迎娶宇治大女公子同居。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, rebuilt the Sanjo palace that had burned in a fire that spring, intending to receive the elder Uji princess there properly as his wife.

units.source_text: 他想：“我当臣下的，毕竟自由得多。

en.t: He thought, "As a subject, I am much freer after all.

units.source_text: 匂亲王如此痛苦地想念二女公子，而只能提心吊胆地偷期相会，弄得彼此都很苦恼，实在十分可怜。

en.t: Prince Niou longs so painfully for the younger princess, yet he can only meet her in secret with constant fear, leaving them both distressed; it is truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 我想索性把他们私通之事告诉了皇后和皇上。

en.t: I think I should simply tell the Empress and the Emperor about their secret affair.

units.source_text: 那时匂亲王暂时被人纷纷议论，虽然略感烦恼，但为二女公子计，是有利而无害的。

en.t: Then Prince Niou would be talked about for a while and might feel somewhat troubled, but for the younger princess it would bring benefit and no harm.

units.source_text: 像现在这样一夜也不得从容相聚，实在是痛苦的啊！

en.t: To be unable even for one night to spend time together calmly, as things are now, is truly painful.

units.source_text: 我想使二女公子当一位堂堂的亲王夫人才好。”

en.t: I think it would be best to make the younger princess a proper and respected prince's wife."

units.source_text: 他这企图并不十分保守秘密。

en.t: He did not keep this plan especially secret.

units.source_text: 到了更衣节，他想：“除我之外，有谁顾念宇治的女公子呢？”

en.t: When the season for changing robes arrived, he thought, "Who besides me will care for the ladies of Uji?"

units.source_text: 便把三条宫邸落成后移居时备用的帐幔等物，悄悄地送往宇治，让她们先用。

en.t: So he quietly sent to Uji the curtains, hangings, and other furnishings prepared for his move once the Sanjo palace was completed, letting them use them first.

units.source_text: 又吩咐乳母等特地为宇治的侍女们新制种种服装，一并送去。

en.t: He also ordered the nurses and others to have various new garments specially made for the Uji attendants and sent them all together.
